title: Earn a Tier 3 mastery token
description:
Explore a style that suits you: shield and steel, a mobile bow, or spells with reliable recovery. Demi's Sky and Ice Arenas have been removed from this test version.

Earn a Tier 3 mastery token.

This entry records that you read the advice. It does not detect a fight, gear quality, a completed expedition or a claimed reward.

objectives.name: Read and acknowledge this expedition note
